svg.title: Optional Homeboard TV cleanup and restore mockups
svg.desc: Six screens show entering cleanup, connecting a companion, read-only results, reviewing selected changes, a stopped operation and restoration. Labels and counts are illustrative.
svg.text: Copy proven cleanup and restore behavior. Keep Homeboard and everyday TV services.

g.text: 01 TV · Settings → More → TV cleanup
An optional setup step for this TV.
Review unwanted background apps with a companion.
Your dashboard and casting stay as they are.
Nothing changes when you open this screen.
Use your trusted setup companion to continue.
Recovery is available even if Homeboard is closed.
